examples.quote: The preceding exploratory replay suggests that the food-related mixture contrast shifts between young and old parents when the reproductive threshold changes. To test whether access to reproduction at those ages affects that population pattern, intervene on reproduction in a 2-by-2 factorial: young gate off/on (parents under 50) and old gate off/on (parents 150 or older). In an active band, independently keyed deterministic pseudorandom assignment blocks approximately half of eligible reproductive opportunities. The key uses source seed, individual ID and tick, consumes no simulation RNG, and is shared across matched arms. The sham invokes the same observer but blocks nothing. The mechanism acts after age, energy and cap eligibility and before mate, local-space and reproductive costs; blocked opportunities therefore retain their potential energy cost. Other ages and opportunities remain unchanged.
